title: Unleashing Generalization of End-to-End Autonomous Driving with Controllable Long Video Generation
control_family: layout, box, map or BEV conditioning

output_modality.value: Multi-view driving video, up to 40 frames (12 seconds).

control_signal.value: BEV layout (foreground object boxes, background map classes) plus scene captions enabling scene-level edits (weather, time) and instance-level edits (object appearance).

control_mechanism.value: Shared-noise reinitialization across views and frames, plus scene- and instance-aware cross-frame attention for consistency. How the BEV layout is injected is not stated in packet.

base_model.value: Diffusion U-Net generator in two variants: 0.5B multi-view single-frame and 1.1B multi-view multi-frame.

datasets.value: nuScenes (150 validation scenes of about 40 frames each); generated data used to fine-tune the UniAD planner.

metrics.value: FID, FVD, CLIP score; BEV detection NDS (StreamPETR) and UniAD average collision rate on generated data.

controllability_evidence.value: Scene plus instance editing lowers UniAD average collision rate from 0.34 to 0.27 (Table 4); failure-case sampling with 972 generated cases (4%) gives 25% improvement.

closed_loop.value: No. Authors state the framework works only open-loop because layout cannot change.

stated_limitations.value: Takes BEV layout as input so only appearance can be enriched, not layout; open-loop only; failure-case sampling fails if the end-to-end model is already perfect on training data.

notes: Text captions also steer edits, so multi-condition reading is possible. Control-effectiveness evidence is mainly downstream planning, not layout-adherence measured directly in the packet.
